citations.claim: first violating step where controller force 214.765 exceeds fmax 171.705

counterfactual.change: Set controller noise from 0.237 to 0.0 only; clamped force then equals fmax exactly and no violation occurs, showing noise added after/without clamp causes overshoot.

explanation: Controller clamps the nominal kp velocity-error force to fmax but then adds seeded sensor noise afterwards without re-clamping. With noise=0 force is exactly fmax (171.705, inspected in counterfactual); with noise=0.237 same gains produce 214.765 >171.705 at step 1. So noise path bypasses force limit.
vision_note: The red controller-driven body starts left of the green waypoint in frame 0. In frame 1 it remains in nearly the same position with no visible collision, escape, or large jump.
